A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' once lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarafur]], which at some point became a tide-locked world. The [[Species/Legends|species]] built many unusual [[Stone/Legends|stone]] structures in the zone separating the planet's illuminated and dark sides, establishing a bustling [[City/Legends|city]] there.

At one point by [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Killik Sith warrior|Killik Sith warrior]] took up refuge in the city, ultimately becoming [[Killik Sith warrior's tomb|entombed]] in a building that the native inhabitants had used for bathing in [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]] [[mineral water]]s. Eventually, eons before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Sarafur species went extinct, and the natives' buildings turned into ruins.

==Society and culture==
[[File:Sarafur-Gamer9.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The species' homeworld, Sarafur]]
Eons before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Tessent">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] resided on [[Sarafur]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]<ref name="Endor" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> At some point, Sarafur had become tidally locked, with some later [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomers]] theorizing that the process had occurred so quickly that the planet's [[Water/Legends|sea]]&mdash;the seabed of which became the [[Krasho Salt Rifts]] region&mdash;had evaporated in as quickly as several [[Local year|years]] or even just [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="Tessent" />

The species built many unusual structures, some of them multiple stories high, that were carved out of gigantic blocks of [[Stone/Legends|stone]]<ref name="Endor" /> such as [[Basalt/Legends|basalt]] and [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]]<ref name="Tessent" /> and that came to rest in the border region between the illuminated and dark sides of Sarafur's surface.<ref name="Endor" /> At the edge of what would eventually be the Krasho Salt Rifts, Sarafur's inhabitants established a bustling [[City/Legends|city]]. One of the settlement's buildings housed a [[Killik Sith warrior's tomb|building]] where the natives bathed in [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]] [[mineral water]]s. The area also housed an arena, and, according to some later [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]], among the ruins on Sarafur was a crypt of a [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] ruler, as well.<ref name="Tessent" />

==History==
[[File:Killik-TUR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Killik Sith warrior (a Killik pictured) lived in and was entombed in a city of the Sarafur species.]]
Sarafur, the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of its native species,<ref name="Endor" /> served as a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of the [[Hive mind/Legends|hive-minded]], [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] before their disappearance from the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]]. Between approximately that date and [[25,200 BBY]], Sarafur also fell under the control of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species.<ref name="TEA" />

When a [[Unidentified Killik Sith warrior|Killik Sith warrior]] fled persecution on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] long before [[Human/Legends|Humans]] settled there<ref name="Tessent" /> between [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]] and [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> he took up refuge on Sarafur, in the city of its inhabitants. When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] died, he was [[Burial/Legends|entombed]] in the building housing the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] water baths. At some point, long before the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Empire, the species that lived on Sarafur became extinct, with the structures it had built ultimately becoming collapsed ruins.<ref name="Tessent" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sarafur species was introduced in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine,<ref name="Endor" /> published on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> Within the magazine, the species was mentioned in the source article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]" as well as the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Race for the Tessent]]," both being written for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Endor" /><ref name="Tessent" />
